title: feat: migrate CLI architecture from Commander.js to oclif
body:
Current CLI uses Commander.js with a custom `loadPluginCommands` mechanism that requires `objectstack.config.ts` to discover plugin commands — making cloud commands (`os login`, `os push`) unusable before project init (chicken-egg problem). Migrates to oclif for native plugin discovery, unified `bin/os` entry, and decoupled command extension.

## Command Migration

- All 16 commands converted from `new Command('name').action(...)` → `class extends Command { async run() }` 
- `plugin` subcommands split into topic dir: `commands/plugin/{list,info,add,remove}.ts`
- `codemod` subcommands split into topic dir: `commands/codemod/v2-to-v3.ts`

```typescript
// Before (Commander.js)
export const compileCommand = new Command('compile')
  .description('Compile ObjectStack configuration')
  .option('-o, --output <path>', 'Output path', 'dist/objectstack.json')
  .action(async (configPath, options) => { ... });

// After (oclif)
export default class Compile extends Command {
  static override description = 'Compile ObjectStack configuration to JSON artifact';
  static override flags = {
    output: Flags.string({ char: 'o', description: 'Output path', default: 'dist/objectstack.json' }),
  };
  async run(): Promise<void> {
    const { args, flags } = await this.parse(Compile);
    ...
  }
}
```

## Plugin System

- Removed `loadPluginCommands` + `plugin-commands.ts` — replaced by oclif's native plugin system
- `@oclif/plugin-help` for auto-generated help, `@oclif/plugin-plugins` for runtime plugin install
- Cloud/third-party commands extend via `os plugins install <pkg>` — no project config needed

## Build & Entry Points

- Build changed from `tsup` → `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json` (oclif needs preserved file structure for command discovery)
- New `bin/run.js` / `bin/run-dev.js` using oclif `execute()`; removed old `bin/objectstack.js`
- `package.json` gains `oclif` config section with pattern-based command discovery

## Spec Updates

- `cli-extension.zod.ts` documentation updated for oclif plugin model
- Added `OclifPluginConfigSchema` for validating plugin `package.json` oclif sections
- Removed `CLIExtensionExportSchema` (Commander.js-specific)

## Tests

- 35 CLI tests updated for oclif static property assertions
- 5520 spec tests unchanged and passing
- New tests for oclif package.json configuration validation

> <issue_title>迁移 CLI 架构到 oclif，实现主 CLI 与插件自动分离</issue_title>
> <issue_description>### 背景
> 当前 ObjectStack CLI 基于 Commander.js，自定义了一套插件注册机制（loadPluginCommands）进行命令扩展，但：
> - 存在命令入口冲突（spec 和 cloud 各有 @objectstack/cli，bin 均为 os）
> - 插件自动发现机制依赖项目 config 文件，导致 os login、os push 等云端命令在未初始化项目时无法使用（鸡蛋问题）
> - 插件注册、加载、失败处理、版本兼容等都需自维护
> 
> ### 行动目标
> 迁移 ObjectStack 主 CLI 架构为 [oclif](https://oclif.io/)，以便：
> - 主 CLI 与云端/第三方插件通过 oclif 内置机制解耦，bin/os 统一
> - 删除自定义 loadPluginCommands 等机制，利用 oclif 自动命令发现与插件注册
> - 按 oclif 典型结构将 packages/cli/src/commands 分为本地开发相关子命令包
> - 为 cloud 项目的云端命令预留 plugin 注册入口
> 
> ### 工作内容
> 1. 使用 oclif 脚手架生成新的主 CLI 骨架（bin: os）
> 2. 将现有本地相关命令（init、dev、serve、plugin、compile、validate、generate、create、test、doctor、lint、diff、explain、codemod 等）迁移为 src/commands/ 下对应 TS class
> 3. 保持主 CLI package.json 的 bin/os 唯一性，移除独立 cloud cli
> 4. 移除 loadPluginCommands，相关扩展点迁移为 oclif plugins
> 5. 提供插件注册与文档说明
> 
> ### 验收标准
> - 用户全局安装 @objectstack/cli 后直接获得 "os" 主命令、所有子命令与自动 help
> - cloud 项目的命令可通过 plugin 引入自动获得
> - 项目内 objectstack.config.ts plugins 不再决定主 CLI 命令集合
> - 提供迁移文档、测试用例
> 
> ---
